detailed.name: Florida
detailed.summary: Florida requires boater education for anyone born on or after January 1, 1988, who operates a motorboat of 10 horsepower or more. You pass an approved course and exam, then carry your Boating Safety Education ID Card from the Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission (FWC).
facts: Anyone born on or after January 1, 1988, operating a motorboat of 10 horsepower or more. This includes nonresidents.
A Boating Safety Education Identification Card issued by the FWC.
Complete an FWC-approved boating safety course and pass its exam, online or in a classroom.
You must carry the card and a photo ID while operating.
A person who operates a boat within 90 days of buying it does not need the card if a bill of sale meeting Florida law is aboard.
Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission (FWC)
steps: Check whether you were born on or after January 1, 1988, and will operate a motorboat of 10 horsepower or more.
Choose an FWC-approved boating safety course, online or in person.
Study the course and pass the final exam.
Get your Boating Safety Education ID Card from the FWC.
Carry the card and a photo ID whenever you operate a boat.
faq: Do I need a boating license in Florida?
Florida does not issue a boating license. If you were born on or after January 1, 1988, you need a Boating Safety Education ID Card to operate a motorboat of 10 horsepower or more.
Does the requirement apply to visitors?
Yes. Nonresidents born on or after January 1, 1988, need the card or an approved equivalent. Check the FWC FAQ for which out-of-state certificates are accepted.
Do I need the card for a kayak?
No. The requirement applies to motorboats of 10 horsepower or more.
sources: FWC, FAQs About Boating Safety Education Requirements

detailed.name: Tennessee
detailed.summary: Tennessee residents born after January 1, 1989, must pass the Tennessee Wildlife Resources Agency (TWRA) boating safety exam before operating a motorized vessel over 8.5 horsepower.
facts: Tennessee residents born after January 1, 1989, operating a motorized vessel over 8.5 horsepower.
Buy the TWRA exam permit, then pass the boating safety exam online or through an instructor-led class.
TWRA accepts NASBLA-approved boating safety certificates from other states.
There is no exemption for people renting a boat.
A supervising adult must be over 18 and either born on or before January 1, 1989, or hold a boater education certificate.
steps: Check whether you were born after January 1, 1989, and will operate a vessel over 8.5 horsepower.
Buy the TWRA boating safety exam permit online or from a license agent.
Study the Tennessee boating handbook or take an instructor-led class.
Pass the boating safety exam online or in class.
Carry your certificate when you operate a boat.
faq: Do I need a boating license in Tennessee?
If you were born after January 1, 1989, you need a TWRA boater education certificate to operate a motorized vessel over 8.5 horsepower.
Does it apply if I rent a boat?
Yes. Tennessee removed the rental exemption, so renters need the certificate too.
Can I use my certificate from another state?
Yes. TWRA accepts NASBLA-approved boating safety certificates from other states.

detailed.name: Michigan
detailed.summary: Michigan requires a boating safety certificate for operators born after June 30, 1996, and for most personal watercraft operators. Courses are available online or in a classroom.
facts: Operators born after June 30, 1996, need a boating safety certificate.
Most PWC operators need a certificate, with age-based rules for younger riders. Check the Michigan DNR for current PWC age limits.
Complete an approved boating safety course online or in a classroom and pass its exam.
You can look up your certificate number and print a copy through the DNR eLicense system.
steps: Check whether you were born after June 30, 1996, or plan to operate a personal watercraft.
Choose an approved boating safety course, online or in a classroom.
Carry your boating safety certificate when operating.
faq: Do I need a boating license in Michigan?
Michigan requires a boating safety certificate rather than a license, for operators born after June 30, 1996, and most personal watercraft operators.
I lost my certificate. How do I get a copy?
Look up your certificate number and print a copy through the Michigan DNR eLicense system.
Are there age limits for jet skis?
Yes. Michigan has age-based rules for personal watercraft operators. Check the DNR's current rules before letting a young rider operate one.

detailed.name: Texas
detailed.summary: Texas requires a Texas Parks and Wildlife Department (TPWD) certified boater education course for anyone born on or after September 1, 1993, who operates a boat with a motor over 15 horsepower, a sailboat over 14 feet, or a personal watercraft.
facts: Anyone born on or after September 1, 1993, operating a vessel with a motor over 15 horsepower, a wind-blown vessel over 14 feet, or a personal watercraft.
Complete a TPWD-certified boater education course, online or in a classroom.
You need your course certificate and a valid photo ID while operating.
An operator who has not taken the course may operate if accompanied by someone 18 or older who meets the education requirement or is exempt by age.
Nonresidents may use a NASBLA-approved boater education certificate from their home state.
steps: Check whether you were born on or after September 1, 1993, and will operate a covered vessel.
Choose a TPWD-certified boater education course, online or in a classroom.
Carry your certificate and photo ID whenever you operate.
faq: Do I need a boating license in Texas?
Texas requires boater education, not a license, for operators born on or after September 1, 1993, who run a boat over 15 horsepower, a sailboat over 14 feet or a personal watercraft.
Can someone without the course drive if I'm on board?
Yes, if the person accompanying them is 18 or older and meets the education requirement or is exempt by age.
Is my out-of-state card valid in Texas?
Yes, if it is a NASBLA-approved boater education certificate from your home state.
